scripts.codegen: orval --config ./orval.config.ts && find ../../lib/api-zod/src/generated -name '*.ts' -exec sed -i "s|from 'zod'|from 'zod/v4'|g" {} \; && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const api=fs.readFileSync('../../lib/api-zod/src/generated/api.ts','utf8');const dir='../../lib/api-zod/src/generated/types';const removed=[];fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f!=='index.ts').forEach(f=>{const name=f.replace('.ts','');const pascal=name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+name.slice(1).replace(/-([a-z])/g,(_,c)=>c.toUpperCase());if(api.includes('export const '+pascal)){fs.unlinkSync(dir+'/'+f);removed.push(name);console.log('Removed conflicting type file:',f);}});if(removed.length){const idx=dir+'/index.ts';let content=fs.readFileSync(idx,'utf8');removed.forEach(n=>{content=content.split('\n').filter(l=>!l.includes(\"./\"+n)).join('\n');});fs.writeFileSync(idx,content);}" && pnpm -w run typecheck:libs
